title: Reversal of a three-candidate ranking
statement: For three candidates $a,b,c$, define the reversal of a ranking by placing its last-ranked candidate first, its middle candidate second, and its first candidate last; thus, for example, $a>b>c$ is sent to $c>b>a$.
